#Other stuff

##### Bryce canyon visitation and water use

```{r}

# NPS monthly visitor information
bryce_visitors <- getUnitVisitation(units = "BRCA", startYear = 1979, endYear = 2024) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(ym = lubridate::ym(paste0(Year, "-", Month))) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TotalVisitors = RecreationVisitors + NonRecreationVisitors) %>%
  dplyr::select(ym, TotalVisitors) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(TotalVisitors = ifelse(TotalVisitors == 0,NA,TotalVisitors))

# NPS visitation summarized to annual
bryce_visitors_an <- bryce_visitors %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(ym)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ym) %>%
  dplyr::summarize_all(.funs = sum)





# Get water use data from the state of Utah:
water_supply_id <- getWaterSuppliersUtah(aoi = getParkBoundary("BRCA")) %>%
  filter(grepl("National", WRNAME, ignore.case=TRUE) | 
           grepl("National", WRENAME, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>%
  .$WRID

  
brca_monthly_use <- map_dfr(water_supply_id, 
                       \(x) getWaterUseUtah(WRID = x)[[1]] %>%
                         dplyr::filter(!is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Year)))) %>%
                         tidyr::pivot_longer(-c("Year", "Method of Measurement"), 
                                             names_to = "month", 
                                             values_to = "use_acre_feet") %>%
                         dplyr::filter(month != "Annual inAcre Feet") %>%
                         dplyr::mutate(ym = lubridate::ym(paste0(Year, "-", month))) %>%
                         drop_na(ym) %>%
                         dplyr::group_by(ym) %>%
                         dplyr::summarize(use_acre_feet = sum(as.numeric(use_acre_feet), 
                                                              na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
                         mutate(WRID=paste0("WRID_",x))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(use_ft3 = use_acre_feet * 43559.9) %>%
    full_join(bryce_visitors, by = "ym") %>%
    mutate(use_ft3 = ifelse(use_ft3 == 0, NA, use_ft3)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(use_per_visitor = use_ft3/TotalVisitors)
  
  brca_annual_use <- map_dfr(water_supply_id, 
                             \(x) getWaterUseUtah(WRID = x)[[1]] %>%
                               dplyr::filter(!is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Year)))) %>%
                               tidyr::pivot_longer(-c("Year", "Method of Measurement"), 
                                                   names_to = "month", 
                                                   values_to = "use_acre_feet")%>%
                               dplyr::filter(month == "Annual inAcre Feet") %>%
                               rename(year = Year) %>%
                               group_by(year) %>%
                               dplyr::summarize(use_acre_feet = sum(as.numeric(use_acre_feet), 
                                                                    na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
                               mutate(WRID=paste0("WRID_",x))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(year = as.numeric(year),
                  use_ft3 = use_acre_feet * 43559.9) %>%
    full_join(bryce_visitors_an, by = "year") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(use_per_visitor = use_ft3/TotalVisitors)

  
brca_use_stats <- brca_monthly_use %>%
  dplyr::mutate(use_per_visitor = use_ft3/TotalVisitors) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean_use_pp = mean(use_per_visitor, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sd_use_pp = sd(use_per_visitor, na.rm = TRUE),
                   cv_use_pp = sd_use_pp / mean_use_pp)

brca_use_stats_an <- brca_annual_use %>%
  dplyr::mutate(use_per_visitor = use_ft3/TotalVisitors) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean_use_pp = mean(use_per_visitor, na.rm = TRUE),
                   sd_use_pp = sd(use_per_visitor, na.rm = TRUE),
                   cv_use_pp = sd_use_pp / mean_use_pp)

avg_use_per_visitor <- brca_annual_use %>%
  dplyr::filter(year >= 2000) %>%
  dplyr::pull(use_per_visitor) %>%
  mean()

ggplot(brca_monthly_use %>% dplyr::filter(year(ym) > 2010), aes(x = ym, y = use_per_visitor)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(brca_monthly_use, aes(x = TotalVisitors, y = use_ft3)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth()
```

```{r compare_weather}
snow_comp <- snotel %>%
  dplyr::filter(site == "708") %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::filter(sensor_id %in% c("PREC.I", "SNWD.I", "WTEQ.I")) %>%
  dplyr::select(date, value, sensor_id, water_year) %>%
```

##### Baseflow estimation

```{r}

k <- 0.9

jemez_discharge_bf <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::select(date, discharge_cfs, discharge_cfs_wbm, recharge_cfs_wbm) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(discharge_cfs = ifelse(is.na(discharge_cfs), discharge_cfs_wbm, discharge_cfs)) %>%
  dplyr::filter((year(date) > 2010) & (year(date) < 2014)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(lynehollick_bf = gr_baseflow(Q = discharge_cfs, method = "lynehollick", a = k),
                boughton_bf = gr_baseflow(Q = discharge_cfs, method = "boughton", k = k),
                jakeman_bf = gr_baseflow(Q = discharge_cfs, method = "jakeman", k = k),
                maxwell_bf = gr_baseflow(Q = discharge_cfs, method = "maxwell", k = k)) 

mean_recharge <- jemez_discharge_bf %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(recharge_cfs_wbm, lynehollick_bf, boughton_bf, jakeman_bf, maxwell_bf) %>%
  dplyr::summarize_all(list(mean))

ggplot(jemez_discharge_bf %>%

  geom_area(aes(date, Qbase), fill = 'orangered', color = 'black') +
  theme_bw() +

  facet_wrap(~Method)
```

```{r}
    theme_bw() +
    labs(y = "daily use (gallons)", x = "") +
    scale_x_date(labels = date_format("%b"))
)
```

# Old figure B6
```{r theis}

drawdown_distance <- function(wells, distances) {
  
  # Initialize a data frame to store drawdown values
  drawdown_df <- tidyr::crossing(wells, distances) %>%
    mutate(drawdown = 0) # Initialize drawdown column
  
  # Calculate drawdown for each well at each distance using dplyr
  drawdown_df <- drawdown_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(runs, distances) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(r = distances, # Distance to the well (already grouped by distance)
                  u = r^2 * S / (4 * T * t),
                # Theis function approximation (good for u < ~0.01,)
      W_u = case_when(
        u < 2 ~ -0.5772 - log(u) + u - u^2/(2*factorial(2)) + u^3/(3*factorial(3)) - u^4/(4*factorial(4)),
        TRUE ~ 0 # Or another appropriate value, consider using a more accurate approximation or expint if u is often > 0.01
      ),
      drawdown = case_when(
        r == 0 ~ Inf, #Or another appropriate value for drawdown at the well itself
        TRUE ~ Q / (4 * pi * T) * W_u # Use Q from wells list
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() 
  
  # Calculate total drawdown at each distance
  total_drawdown <- drawdown_df %>%
    group_by(distances) %>%
    summarize(total_drawdown = sum(drawdown))
  
  #Join to have all values in one dataframe
  drawdown_df <- left_join(drawdown_df, total_drawdown, by = "distances")
  
  return(drawdown_df)
}

# Estimate hydraulic conductivity from Conover report (1962)
conover_transmissivity <- 25000 * 0.00378541 / 0.3048# gallons per day per foot to m3/m
K_est <- conover_transmissivity / (1000*.3048) # assume 1000 ft thick aquifer near pump site


distances <- seq(1, 3*1600, by = 10)  # Distances from 1 to 200


wells <- data.frame(runs = c("K = 1", "K = 10", "K = 0.1"), # ft/day
                    mult = c(1, 10, 0.1)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Q = 327,
                b = 300*.3048,
                K = K_est, # note this and other vals are in m/day (just label is ft/d for plot)
                T = K * b * mult,
                S = 0.005,
                t = 365) %>%
  bind_rows(data.frame(runs = c("K = 1", "K = 10", "K = 0.1"), # ft/day
                    mult = c(1, 10, 0.1)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Q = 327,
                b = 300*.3048,
                K = K_est, # note this and other vals are in m/day (just label is ft/d for plot)
                T = K * b * mult,
                S = 0.005,
                t = 10* 365))

drawdown <- drawdown_distance(wells, distances) 

# Plotting (example - using ggplot2 which is also in the tidyverse):

theis_drawdown <- ggplot(drawdown %>%
         dplyr::mutate(facet_var = paste0("Pumping ", t/365, " year(s)")), aes(x = distances/1609.34, y = -drawdown/0.3048, color = runs)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = runs), color = "black", lwd = 1.5, lineend = "round") +
  geom_line(lwd = 1, lineend = "round") +
  labs(x = "Distance (mi)", y = "Drawdown (ft)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(1:length(wells), "black")) +  # Customize colors
  theme_bw() +
  scale_color_manual(c(expression(K~(ft~day^-1))), values = c(pal$gold, pal$darkblue, pal$orange)) +
```

Frequency of extreme (p99) discharge events.

```{r figure_b3}
df <- wbm %>%
  dplyr::rename(cf = CF) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cf) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(rolling_3day = frollapply(discharge_in_wbm, FUN = "sum", n = 3, align = "center"),
                date = as_date(date),
                year = year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(rolling_3day))

var = "rolling_3day"
q1 = 0.1 
q2 = 0.99

historic <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(cf == "Historical") %>%
  dplyr::rename("variable" = var) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Explore runoff events ONLY:
  dplyr::filter(variable > 0,
                # AND only data from 1979-2012
                year >= hist_yrs[1] & year < hist_yrs[2]) %>%
  dplyr::select(variable) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(QLOW = quantile(variable, probs = as.numeric(q1)),
                   QHIGH = quantile(variable, probs = as.numeric(q2)))

year_counts <- df %>%
  dplyr::rename("variable" = var) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(low_day = ifelse(variable <= historic$QLOW, 1, 0),
                high_day = ifelse(variable >= historic$QHIGH, 1, 0)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = year(date)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cf, year) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(n_low_days = sum(low_day),
                   n_high_days = sum(high_day)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(type = ifelse(cf == "Historical", "Historical", "Future"))

sanity_check <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(rolling_3day >= historic$QHIGH)

stats_discharge <- year_counts %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(year >= hist_yrs[[1]] & year < hist_yrs[[2]] | year >= fut_yrs[[1]] & year < fut_yrs[[2]]) %>%
  group_by(cf) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(high_count = sum(n_high_days, na.rm = TRUE),
            high_mean = mean(n_high_days, na.rm = TRUE),
            low_count = sum(n_low_days, na.rm = TRUE),
            low_mean = mean(n_low_days, na.rm = TRUE))
```
